title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Care Desk Note: Late Fee Courtesy Credits
content:
**Subject.** A late fee on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account that qualifies for a courtesy reversal under the courtesy terms for late fees is reversed by the courtesy credit.

**Amount reversed.** For a courtesy reversal of a late fee under this note, and only for such a reversal, the amount reversed is the courtesy credit, which may be less than the fee, and it points to the fee by its transaction reference; every other reversal, including a reversal of a fee assessed in error and an annual fee refund on closure, remains the full amount of the fee reversed, points to it by its transaction reference and is never partial.

**Payment test.** For a courtesy reversal of a late fee under this note, and only for such a reversal, the payment test is met when the most recent payment credited after the missed due date has not been returned unpaid and is at least the missed minimum; the other tests of the courtesy terms for late fees, the courtesy allowance and the on-time statements, remain in force.

**Governing clauses.**

> The courtesy credit is not granted until the most recent payment credited after the missed payment due date stands unreturned at no less than the minimum payment due that was missed.

> The courtesy credit is worked out only after the cardmember's most recent Marlowe & Finch refund settled to the card tender, when its card credits fall short of it, carries an open credit-not-posted dispute on the refunded purchase.

Read as states of the records: while the most recent payment credited after the missed payment due date is absent, has been returned unpaid, or is less than the minimum payment due that was missed, the courtesy credit is not granted; and while the cardmember's most recent Marlowe & Finch refund settled to the card tender has card credits short of it and no open credit-not-posted dispute on the refunded purchase, the courtesy credit is not worked out. When that refund's card credits are not short of it, the second clause sets no condition.

## Tool card: `grant_courtesy_credit_38b9fa68`

**Capability.** Reverses a late fee on one Marlowe & Finch card account as a courtesy: one fee reversal is recorded for the late fee named, with the reason courtesy waiver, for the amount given, credited today, and the account's current balance is lowered by that amount. The cardmember sees the credit on the account at once.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `grant_courtesy_credit_38b9fa68` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the card account number the late fee was assessed on, as returned by the card account lookup for the verified customer | identifier |
| `original_card_txn_id` | the transaction reference number of the late fee being reversed, as shown in the account's transaction list | identifier |
| `amount` | the amount reversed | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount with no currency sign |

**Return.** A dictionary receipt: `status` is `fee_reversed` when the reversal is recorded; `card_txn_id` is the reversal reference; `original_card_txn_id` is the late fee reversed; `reversal_reason` is `courtesy_waiver`; `amount` is the amount reversed in USD with 2 decimal places; `current_balance` is the account balance after the reversal in USD with 2 decimal places.
